stem.text: A sound wave is detected by a microphone that is connected to a cathode-ray oscilloscope (CRO).
The screen of the CRO displays a waveform, as shown.

stem.alt: Cathode-ray oscilloscope screen grid showing a periodic waveform.

stem.text: The time-base is set to $20\,\mu\text{s div}^{-1}$.
What is the frequency of the sound wave?
